messages:
marta: quick FYI — ran into a weird auth routing quirk in prod: service-account requests sometimes land on the fallback proxy and get billed to the org owner instead of the project. noticed it after a batch rotate.

josh: ugh, saw a tiny blip in billing attribution last week, but didn’t connect it to SA rotation. any logs?

marta: pasted a snippet below, redacted keys obviously. shows `auth:exchange -> proxy-v2 (ok)` then next request `auth:exchange -> fallback-proxy` with reason `KV_CACHE_MISS`

marta: ```
2026-05-12T10:23:41Z TRACE id=abc123 route=auth-exchange status=200 target=proxy-v2 reason=OK
2026-05-12T10:23:42Z TRACE id=abc124 route=auth-exchange status=200 target=fallback-proxy reason=KV_CACHE_MISS
```

devin: that KV cache miss makes sense if the SA rotation window hadn't propagated to the routing layer. are we invalidating prefix caches on rotation?

marta: looks like we currently only invalidate in the token service; router has a 30s TTL and relies on the token introspect cache to refresh.

samir: TTL + async propagation -> risk window. we should either proactively publish invalidation events or add a short-lived sticky mapping for new tokens.

lisa: from the console POV, users see a sudden project attribution mismatch in the dashboard, which trips alerts. they expect no billing noise on rotation. need a UX mitigation too.

josh: agree. two parallel work items: (1) routing/telemetry so we can root-cause and alert earlier, (2) console UX to show \"attribution instability\" during rotates and offer remediation.

marta: proposal for telemetry: emit `auth.routing.event` with fields: `token_id_hash`, `origin_project`, `target_cluster`, `fallback_reason`, `trace_id`. sample at 100% for now for rotates, 1% baseline. but careful about PII — only hashes for token ids.

devin: +1 on hashed ids. also include `sa_rotation_epoch` boolean so we can correlate. sampling needs to be adjustable per-tenant.

samir: implementation note — router has limited uplink; prefer compact metric via event telemetry + separate detailed log dump for sampled requests. avoid sending full headers to central.

lisa: for console UX: show a transient banner on project billing page: \"Billing attributions may be delayed during key rotations — check routing debug tab.\" include a link to a minimal debug view that surfaces `latest_routing_events` for the project.

josh: sounds reasonable. question: do we show fallback reason to end-users? e.g., `KV_CACHE_MISS` might be noisy/technical. maybe map to friendlier: `routing-cache-refresh` or `regional-failover`.

marta: yeah map reasons to friendly strings. keep raw reason in telemetry but not in UI.

devin: timeline: I can spike router telemetry change (emit compact event) today, get a flag behind `router.telemetry.rotate_debug` and wire a sample sink. expected 1d for spike -> staging test.

samir: I'll design the event schema and quota envelope so this doesn't flood our telemetry quota. propose default sample rates: rotate window 100% for 60m, otherwise 0.5%.

lisa: I'll draft the console banner + debug tab layout. want it minimal. also add an opt-out for customers who don't want telemetry surfaced.

marta: one more thing — cross-check billing pipeline: when fallback-target differs from origin attribution we should tag the billing record with `routing_override=true` so downstream teams can filter anomalies.

josh: good call. ops: infra-bot, any capacity concerns for short high-sample windows?

infra-bot: alert: projected telemetry ingest increase of ~0.4% during a 60m 100% sample window for rotated tenants. No quota breach expected for current month.

samir: perfect. action items: devin implement router flag + event (PR -> #staging tomorrow), samir finalize schema and sampling defaults, lisa wire banner & debug view mock, marta coordinate one customer rotate to test.

marta: thanks all — will pick a low-impact tenant to test and post results here. :thumbsup:

josh: cheers, keep us posted. :eyes:
